hero.name: Kshitij Bajpai
hero.headline: Designing reliable workflow-driven backend systems for financial platforms, logistics, and enterprise software.
hero.quote: Good backend systems aren't judged when everything works. They're judged by how gracefully they recover when things don't.

philosophy.title: How I Approach Software Engineering
philosophy.description: I enjoy designing backend systems that continue to work when reality doesn't go according to plan. For me, writing code is only one part of engineering; understanding failure, scale and operational behavior is where the real work begins.

cards.title: Design for Failure
cards.description: Every distributed system eventually fails. Good engineering is designing how software recovers when it does.

cards.title: Think in Systems
cards.description: I enjoy understanding workflows, architecture and dependencies before writing code.

cards.title: Production Ownership
cards.description: Production incidents are opportunities to understand how real systems behave under pressure.

philosophy.quote: Design is where engineering begins. Code is simply one way to express it.

timeline.title: Software Development Engineer II
highlights: Reduced mandate presentation processing from nearly one day to 1–2 hours.
Built Redis-based payment gateway routing using live success-rate data.
Implemented distributed locking to prevent duplicate repayments and webhook races.
Worked across multiple payment microservices supporting lending workflows.

timeline.title: Software Developer
highlights: Integrated multiple payment gateways through a common abstraction.

timeline.title: Senior System Engineer
highlights: Processed millions of network events through Kafka Streams.
Implemented rule evaluation for telecom throughput optimization.
Worked with Apache Druid time-series analytics.

timeline.title: B.Tech - Computer Science & Engineering
description: Built foundations in software engineering, object-oriented programming, algorithms, and backend systems.
Focused deeply on technical growth and scalable systems thinking.

timeline.title: Secondary Schooling
description: Established strong academic discipline and foundational growth.

systems.title: Dynamic Payment Gateway Routing
systems.problem: Payment gateway availability fluctuated, reducing transaction success rates.
systems.solution: Designed Redis-based routing that selected gateways using live success-rate metrics.
systems.impact: Improved payment reliability and reduced operational intervention.

systems.title: Mandate Processing Engine
systems.problem: Mandate presentation processing required nearly one day.
systems.solution: Optimized workflow execution and backend processing across payment services.
systems.impact: Reduced processing time from roughly one day to nearly one hour.

systems.title: Vendor Bidding Workflow
systems.solution: Designed asynchronous bidding workflows with Kafka event processing.
systems.impact: Improved operational efficiency and shipment allocation.

systems.title: Lawyer Consultation Platform
systems.problem: Consultation scheduling, payments and payouts were fragmented.
systems.solution: Built an integrated workflow connecting meetings, payments, notifications and payouts.
systems.impact: Enabled end-to-end consultation lifecycle through a unified backend.

expertise.title: Backend Engineering
expertise.description: Designing scalable APIs and backend services.

expertise.title: Data Engineering
expertise.description: Optimizing storage, caching and data access.

contact.title: Let's Build Reliable Systems Together
